title: Test harness: vitest setup, pty and TUI snapshot tester, fixtures
goal: A shared test toolkit: Vitest preset with coverage floors and offline enforcement, deterministic helpers (clock, RNG, tmp dirs, fixtures loader), and a pty plus Ink snapshot harness for terminal UI tests.
scope_in: Vitest preset `@centcom/testkit/vitest` (exports `defineCentcomConfig(overrides)`): environment node, `testTimeout` 10 000 ms, `hookTimeout` 10 000 ms, coverage v8 with lines/functions/branches/statements floor 80 and target 90 reported, `retry: 0`, `pool: 'forks'`, deterministic `TZ=UTC`, `LANG=en_US.UTF-8`.

Global setup that blocks real network: patches `net.connect`/`tls.connect`/`dns.lookup` to reject any non-loopback target with an error naming the test; `console.log/info/warn/error` called from library code fails the test unless explicitly allowed.

Deterministic helpers: `fakeClock(start)` (implements the injectable `Clock` and drives Vitest fake timers), `seededRng(seed)`, `fixedIds(seed)` (CT-IDS generator), `tmpDir()` with automatic cleanup, in-memory fs (`memfs`-style adapter implementing the fs interfaces other lanes inject), `loadContractFixture(path)`.

pty harness `PtyHarness`: spawns a command in a pseudo terminal with fixed size (default 100x30), `TERM=xterm-256color`, `COLORTERM=truecolor`, isolated `CENTCOM_CONFIG_DIR`/`CENTCOM_STATE_DIR` temp dirs, `HOME` redirected; `send`, `press`, `waitForText(re, ms=5000)`, `screen()` (rows of plain text from an xterm headless emulator), `cells()` (text + fg/bg + attrs), `resize`, `kill`, `exitCode`.

Ink snapshot tester `renderInk(element, { cols, rows, colorTier })`: renders with a fake TTY stream, returns `frames`, `lastFrame()`, `screen()`; `expectScreen(screen).toMatchSnapshot()` stores ANSI-stripped text snapshots plus an optional color snapshot (`colorTier: 'truecolor'|'256'|'16'|'none'`).
Snapshot update policy: snapshots live next to tests in `__snapshots__/`; CI runs with `--ci` so a missing snapshot fails instead of being written.
A `docs/testing.md` describing conventions: injectable clock/RNG, no real network, 60 s per-lane budget, how to use the mock backend (lane C007).
scope_out: The mock backend itself: lane C007.
CI workflows: lane C002. Example fixtures and seed data: lane C011.
Playwright setup for the web app: web lanes.
Writing the TUI components being tested: TUI lanes.
build_against: Self-testing: the harness is exercised against tiny fixture programs under packages/testkit/src/harness/__fixtures__/ (an echo script, a color printer, an Ink hello component). No backend needed.
interfaces: `interface Clock { now(): number; setTimeout(fn, ms): Handle; clearTimeout(h): void }`; `fakeClock(startMs?: number): Clock & { advance(ms: number): Promise<void>; set(ms: number): void }`.
`seededRng(seed: number): () => number` (xoshiro128**, values in [0,1)); `fixedIds(seed: number): IdGenerator` (shape from C003).
`tmpDir(): Promise<{ path: string; dispose(): Promise<void> }>`; `memFs(): FsLike`.

`class PtyHarness { static spawn(cmd: string, args: string[], o?: PtyOptions): Promise<PtyHarness>; send(s: string): void; press(key: 'enter'|'esc'|'up'|'down'|'left'|'right'|'tab'|'ctrl-c'|string): void; waitForText(re: RegExp | string, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<void>; screen(): string[]; cells(): Cell[][]; resize(cols: number, rows: number): void; kill(): Promise<number> }`.
`renderInk(el: ReactElement, o?: { cols?: number; rows?: number; colorTier?: ColorTier }): InkTestRun`.
acceptance: A test that calls `net.connect({host:'example.com', port:443})` fails with an error containing `network access blocked in tests`; loopback connections to 127.0.0.1 succeed.
`fakeClock(0)`: `advance(1000)` fires a `setTimeout(fn, 999)` exactly once and a 1001 ms timer zero times; two runs produce identical firing order (property test over 200 random timers).

`PtyHarness.spawn('node', ['fixture-echo.js'])` then `send('hello\r')` and `waitForText('hello')` resolves in < 2 s; `waitForText('never')` rejects after exactly the given timeout with the last screen contents (redacted of env values) in the message.
`screen()` of a fixture that prints truecolor text returns plain text rows; `cells()` reports the exact fg hex for each cell; a 100x30 screen has 30 rows of 100 columns.
`renderInk` of a component printing `<Text color='green'>ok</Text>` with `colorTier:'none'` yields no SGR escape codes; with `truecolor` yields `38;2;` sequences.
Coverage: `vitest run --coverage` fails with exit code 1 when lines coverage of a package is below 80%.
The whole harness test-suite finishes in < 30 s on CI and leaves no temp dirs or child processes behind (checked by a leak test).
tests: preset.test.ts (config values), network-guard.test.ts, console-guard.test.ts, clock.test.ts, rng.test.ts, tmpdir.test.ts.
pty.test.ts (spawn, send, wait, timeout, resize, kill, exit code, Windows skip with reason when ConPTY unavailable).
ink.test.ts (frames, color tiers), snapshot-ci.test.ts (missing snapshot fails under --ci), leak.test.ts.
guardrails: MUST NOT allow real outbound network in tests; the guard is on by default and can only be lifted per test file with an explicit `allowNetwork('reason')` that CI greps for.
MUST run spawned programs with an isolated HOME and config/state dirs so tests never read or write the developer's real config or keychain.
MUST NOT include env values or file contents in failure messages beyond the redacted screen text.
Pty/emulator packages MUST be prebuilt-binary or pure JS with no install scripts; justify each in the PR.
Tests MUST be deterministic: no wall-clock sleeps longer than 50 ms; use `fakeClock` or `waitForText`.
failure_modes: PTY unavailable (e.g. Windows without ConPTY) -> `PtyHarness.spawn` throws `PtyUnavailable`; tests use `describe.skipIf` with the reason printed, never silently pass.
Child process hangs -> killed after the harness timeout (default 15 s) with SIGKILL and the test fails with the last screen.
Snapshot differs -> failure shows a unified diff of plain-text rows.
notes: Colour-tier names match assets/DESIGN.md section 19.3 (truecolor, 256, 16, none). SPLIT? pty+emulator and Ink tester could be separate PRs if the pty dependency choice drags.
